Entry Point 01

Schools Inspection Framework (EIF)

Compliance Automation

Automated EIF checks validating evidence against 4 graded judgements: quality of education, behaviour, personal development, leadership.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Pattern recognition to identify schools trending RI/Inadequate before inspection.

Natural Language Policy Analysis

NLP parsing of EIF handbooks and research to extract compliance obligations mapped to school-level evidence.

Predictive Analytics

ML models on historical data forecasting grade outcomes from school characteristics and contextual indicators.

Evidence Synthesis

Synthesis of lesson observations, work scrutiny, pupil voice, and leadership interviews into EIF-aligned portfolios.

Document Intelligence

Extraction from SEFs, improvement plans, and policies against EIF requirements with gap identification.

Stakeholder Reporting

Inspection prep reports, post-inspection plans, governor briefings with grading justification.

Real-time Monitoring

Live dashboards tracking pipeline, inspector assignments, evidence completion, and moderation timelines.
